description.en: Enters "stand event" dialogue mode: adjusts camera depth-of-field, pauses RPG character/map/camera updates, and remembers the previous pause state. Does nothing (and logs a message) if a stand event is already active. Pair with EndStandEvent.
Optional number of frames for the depth-of-field transition (defaults to 10).
No explicit return statement (an early `return;` with no value when already active) — implicitly null.
